text: The Applicant for 409 Gilbert Avenue has requested Toronto and East York Community Council to exempt their property from the following by-law requirements: City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 447 Section 1.2.B(1) fence in rear yard not to exceed 2.0 metres in height. The Applicant for 409 Gilbert Avenue is requesting an exemption for their: Existing wooden fence in rear yard to remain: - Rear fence – Northern lot line 1st fence panel is a height of 3.18 metres at a length of 1.31 metres - Rear fence – Northern lot line 2nd fence panel is a height of 2.85 metres at a length of 1.31 metres - Rear Fence - The average height of both fence panel at the Northern property line is 3.01 metres Proposed wooden fence in front yard: - Front yard – Northern lot line at 2 metres in height for 1.82 metres in length Municipal Licensing and Standards Division has inspected the subject property and…
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Deferred consideration of the Item until the January 2027 meeting of Toronto and East York Community Council.
